title: Distribution benefits (CFCs) — s 47A ITAA 1936
summary: Facet map: is a CFC distribution benefit deemed a dividend under s 47A? Spine: unlisted-country CFC threshold (s 47A(1)(b)-(d), after 3 June 1990) → profits immediately before distribution (s 47A(1)(a), s 47A(15)) → eligible benefit categories — waiver (s 47A(5)-(6)), non-arm's length loan (s 47A(7)), share/right/option acquisition (s 47A(8)), property/services transfer (s 47A(10), s 47A(10A) roll-over carve-out), payment on call (s 47A(11)) → s 47A(9)/(12) exclusions (no other eligible-interest holder) with s 47A(13)-(14) recapture → deemed dividend (s 47A(1)(d)-(g)) → s 44 assessability subject to s 23AI / s 768-5 NANE (s 47A(2)). FACETS: associate definition and benefit timing (s 47A(3)-(4)), recapture (s 47A(13)-(14)), assessment machinery (s 47A(18A), (19), (20)), profits computation (s 47A(15)-(17)). Subsection coverage: s 47A(1)-(21) all mapped.

nodes.label: A CFC provides a distribution benefit — is it deemed a dividend under s 47A?
nodes.body: Single question with facets. Spine: unlisted-country CFC threshold → profits → eligible benefit categories → exclusions → deemed dividend → assessability. Facets carry the machinery.

nodes.label: Is the first company a CFC resident in an unlisted country at the distribution time (s 47A(1)(b)-(d))?
nodes.body: The distribution time must be after 3 June 1990 (s 47A(1)(b)); the company must be a CFC (s 47A(1)(c)) resident in an unlisted country (s 47A(1)(d)). Listed-country CFCs are outside s 47A.

nodes.label: Not an unlisted-country CFC — s 47A does not apply
nodes.body: The benefit may still be a dividend under s 6(1) or caught by other provisions (s 44, Div 7A, transferor trust rules).

nodes.label: Does the company have profits immediately before the distribution time (s 47A(1)(a))?
nodes.body: s 47A(15): profits are computed assuming Part X (except s 47A) had applied — previously attributed income reduces distributable profits.

nodes.label: No profits — no deemed dividend
nodes.body: The benefit is not deemed a dividend under s 47A(1). Other rules may still apply.

nodes.label: Is the benefit a distribution benefit within s 47A(3)-(14)?
nodes.body: s 47A(3): an eligible benefit provided to an associated entity (or to an entity that becomes an associate), subject to ss (9)/(12). The eligible benefit categories are ss (5), (7), (8), (10), (11).

nodes.label: Is it a waiver/release of an obligation (s 47A(5))?
nodes.body: s 47A(5): waiving or releasing an obligation to pay/repay is an eligible benefit. s 47A(6): obligation includes unenforceable or conditional obligations.

nodes.label: Or a non-arm's length loan (s 47A(7))?
nodes.body: s 47A(7): a loan is an eligible benefit where the parties are not at arm's length, or a purpose is to enable the recipient to acquire property/services from the provider or an associate.

nodes.label: Or a share/right/option acquisition (s 47A(8))?
nodes.body: s 47A(8): acquiring a share, right or option from the company is an eligible benefit — subject to the s 47A(9) exclusion (no other eligible-interest holder).

nodes.label: Or a property/services transfer for inadequate consideration (s 47A(10))?
nodes.body: s 47A(10): transferring property/services for no or inadequate consideration is an eligible benefit to the extent of the shortfall. s 47A(10A): certain CGT roll-over transfers (ss 70-30/70-110 ITAA 1997) are not within s 47A(10).

nodes.label: Or a payment on a call on shares (s 47A(11))?
nodes.body: s 47A(11): a payment on a call on shares is an eligible benefit — subject to the s 47A(12) exclusion (mirror of s 47A(9)).

nodes.label: Not an eligible benefit — no deemed dividend
nodes.body: Outside ss 47A(5),(7),(8),(10),(11). Check the s 6(1) dividend definition and other integrity rules.

nodes.label: Do the s 47A(9)/(12) exclusions apply?
nodes.body: s 47A(9) (shares) and (12) (calls): NOT a distribution benefit if there is no entity (other than the provider) holding an eligible equity interest in the first company, or who is an associate of such a holder. s 47A(13)-(14): recapture where the exclusion later ceases to apply.

nodes.label: Excluded — not a distribution benefit
nodes.body: No other eligible-interest holder (s 47A(9)/(12)). Watch recapture under s 47A(13)-(14).

nodes.label: So much of the payment as does not exceed profits is deemed a dividend (s 47A(1)(d)-(g))
nodes.body: Deemed dividend to the recipient as shareholder, out of profits, at the distribution time. Flows into s 44.

nodes.label: Assessable under s 44, or NANE under s 23AI / s 768-5?
nodes.body: s 47A(2): included under s 44 (s 47A(2)(a)(i)) or would be apart from s 23AI / s 768-5 (s 47A(2)(a)(ii)).

nodes.label: NANE under s 23AI / s 768-5 ITAA 1997
nodes.body: Not assessable to that extent — the underlying income was already attributed or the participation exemption applies.

nodes.label: Deemed dividend assessable under s 44
nodes.body: Included in assessable income under s 44. s 47A(18A) allows assessment on the assumption s 47A(2) will not be satisfied.

nodes.label: FACET — Distribution benefit definition and associates (s 47A(3)-(4))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(3) (benefit to an associated entity, or to an entity that becomes associated, or referable to a benefit by an associate); s 47A(4) (undertaking to make arrangement transfers — the distribution time is when the undertaking was entered into). The associate concept follows s 318 Part X.

nodes.label: FACET — Recapture (s 47A(13)-(14))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(13) (benefit excluded only because of ss (9)/(12) later becomes a distribution benefit when another eligible-interest holder appears); s 47A(14) (similar for benefits referable to the recipient's interest). The recapture time determines the distribution time.

nodes.label: FACET — Assessment machinery (ss 47A(18)-(19))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(18A) (assessment on the assumption s 47A(2) will not be satisfied — preserves the Commissioner's ability to assess underlying CFC income); s 47A(19) (s 102AAJ applies — related assessments); s 47A(20) (listed/unlisted question determined under Part X ss 320-321).

nodes.label: FACET — Profits computation (s 47A(15))
nodes.body: Where to look: s 47A(15) — profits determined assuming Part X (except s 47A) applied; s 47A(16)-(17) — timing and eligibility mechanics for benefits across years. The deemed dividend is capped at profits (s 47A(1)(d)).
